findings.title: Stage-nav shell absent from suppliers layout
findings.description: The prototype renders a persistent 01–04 stage rail across every Suppliers surface. The shipped layout drops it entirely, so a user on the Plan step has no way to see or jump between stages. The rail is not hidden behind a breakpoint — it never mounts.

findings.title: Card radius and elevation diverge from the design system
findings.description: Supplier cards ship with an 8px radius and a hard 1px border; the prototype uses a 14px radius with a soft shadow and no border. The delta reads clearly at a glance and breaks visual rhythm with adjacent DS surfaces.

findings.title: No empty state when a supplier has zero orders
findings.description: Navigating to a supplier with no orders shows a blank table with header rows only — no illustration, copy, or CTA. The prototype specifies an empty state with a `Create first order` action.

findings.title: Section labels use Title Case instead of the prototype's UPPERCASE tracking
findings.description: Prototype section labels are 11px uppercase with 0.08em tracking. Shipped labels are 13px Title Case, no tracking. Low impact but breaks the DS label convention used elsewhere.

architecture_notes.title: Stage state lives in three places instead of one
architecture_notes.body: The design implies a single source of truth for the active stage (URL segment). The shipped code duplicates it into React context AND a Zustand store, which drift when the user navigates via the browser back button.

ru.findings[1].title: В layout Suppliers отсутствует rail этапов 01–04
ru.findings[1].description: Прототип показывает постоянный rail этапов 01–04 на всех экранах Suppliers. В реализации он полностью отсутствует — пользователь на шаге «План» не видит этапы и не может между ними переключаться. Rail не спрятан за breakpoint — он вообще не монтируется.
